title: Thaddeus at Egress 2

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: As you said, I am old. Very old. And a long time ago - longer back than I can remember - I had a friend. His name was Thaddeus. I had another name, but I took his.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As you said, I am old. Very old. And a long time ago - longer back than I can remember - I had a friend. His name was Thaddeus. I had another name, but I took his.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I can't remember. Nor can I remember what my original name was. In truth there is a GREAT DEAL I don't remember. But I DO remember when we first built Egress, and what we built it for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't remember. Nor can I remember what my original name was. In truth there is a GREAT DEAL I don't remember. But I DO remember when we first built Egress, and what we built it for.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: In a manner of speaking. Egress is a transmitter, and we based its construction on a similar ancient device. Egress allows the re-writing of the human source code, and through that process, it allows the transmission of memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: In a manner of speaking. Egress is a transmitter, and we based its construction on a similar ancient device. Egress allows the re-writing of the human source code, and through that process, it allows the transmission of memories.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Egress needs a key, and you hold that key. Ava. She facilitates the connection between the human consciousness and Egress.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Egress needs a key, and you hold that key. Ava. She facilitates the connection between the human consciousness and Egress.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I remember now. The problem of eternal life: Personality migration.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I remember now. The problem of eternal life: Personality migration.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: But the mind always fails...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But the mind always fails...

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Exactly. The problem is humans are not meant to live hundreds of years. Their memories fill up and become unstable and their personality collapses.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly. The problem is humans are not meant to live hundreds of years. Their memories fill up and become unstable and their personality collapses.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Yes... those memories must be stored on a suitable medium, or they too will degrade.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... those memories must be stored on a suitable medium, or they too will degrade.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: No. Not only delete them. Retain them. Personality migration is a certainty unless the memories are stored, and can be re-accessed periodically, but they must be stored on a suitable medium.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. Not only delete them. Retain them. Personality migration is a certainty unless the memories are stored, and can be re-accessed periodically, but they must be stored on a suitable medium.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Me? No. I don't think so.... Healthy and stable human minds must store the memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me? No. I don't think so.... Healthy and stable human minds must store the memories.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Yes. I need someone to hold something prescious for me. A great many memories, sorrowful and joyous, mundane and revelatory. Will you hold some for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes. I need someone to hold something prescious for me. A great many memories, sorrowful and joyous, mundane and revelatory. Will you hold some for me?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Who else? What did you think all of this was for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who else? What did you think all of this was for?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Caution is wise... but Thaddeus has few options, and he is also putting his trust in you. And he is running out of time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Caution is wise... but Thaddeus has few options, and he is also putting his trust in you. And he is running out of time.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: That's right, Ava. This transmitter can still read memories, and the one there in Egress can still write them, but both are failing. This is my last shot.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's right, Ava. This transmitter can still read memories, and the one there in Egress can still write them, but both are failing. This is my last shot.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: If the procedure fails, that brain will be... cleared. Nothing will remain of Thaddeus Carminus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If the procedure fails, that brain will be... cleared. Nothing will remain of Thaddeus Carminus.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: So what's your decision? Help an old man out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what's your decision? Help an old man out?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: I understand that feeling, but this is my last chance. I didn't want it to end like this. Would you reconsider?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I understand that feeling, but this is my last chance. I didn't want it to end like this. Would you reconsider?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Hey, I get it. I do. And if I had a bit more time, I could explain why it had to be you. And the truth is, my span has been too long anyways. Maybe it's time I-

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I get it. I do. And if I had a bit more time, I could explain why it had to be you. And the truth is, my span has been too long anyways. Maybe it's time I-

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I think he's gone. The signal is still being broadcast to his hologram, but it's... silent. The process has failed... Goodbye Thaddeus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I think he's gone. The signal is still being broadcast to his hologram, but it's... silent. The process has failed... Goodbye Thaddeus.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Thank you. I'll have to disconnect now. Do not be alarmed when my avatar deactivates. The process will take a little while. You will hear from me again. In some time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you. I'll have to disconnect now. Do not be alarmed when my avatar deactivates. The process will take a little while. You will hear from me again. In some time.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: You're back. Good. I wasn't sure you would dare to.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're back. Good. I wasn't sure you would dare to.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Allowing human memories to be downloaded, shared and, most importantly, deleted.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Allowing human memories to be downloaded, shared and, most importantly, deleted.

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: One needs to delete whole memories, but over time, this leads to “personality migration”.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: One needs to delete whole memories, but over time, this leads to “personality migration”.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The individual changes their values and beliefs based on what they remember.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The individual changes their values and beliefs based on what they remember.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why did you take his name?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why did you take his name?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why did you take his name?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why did you take his name?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Prolonging life.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Prolonging life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Storing memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Storing memories.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How does it work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does it work?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Exactly that. We have eradicated physical death - if you have the will and the finances to pursue that goal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly that. We have eradicated physical death - if you have the will and the finances to pursue that goal.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava stores the memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava stores the memories.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Another human mind must hold the memories.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another human mind must hold the memories.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Another human mind must hold the memories.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Another human mind must hold the memories.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What would it involve?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What would it involve?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: Nothing traumatic. You might just find your head a little fuller than it was before. But you must choose quickly. I don't have much time, and this process has only a limited chance of success.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing traumatic. You might just find your head a little fuller than it was before. But you must choose quickly. I don't have much time, and this process has only a limited chance of success.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm not sure about this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sure about this.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I need some reassurances I won't be harmed.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need some reassurances I won't be harmed.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I need some reassurances I won't be harmed.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I need some reassurances I won't be harmed.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does the process involve?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does the process involve?

nodes.speaker: Thaddeus Carminus
nodes.text: For you? Almost nothing. For me? Right now, my physical mind - my brain - is floating in a cerebral fluid inside something very similar to a glass jar.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For you? Almost nothing. For me? Right now, my physical mind - my brain - is floating in a cerebral fluid inside something very similar to a glass jar.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You lied to me and tricked me. I won't help.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You lied to me and tricked me. I won't help.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You lied to me and tricked me. I won't help.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You lied to me and tricked me. I won't help.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I want to help but it feels risky. I'm sorry.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I want to help but it feels risky. I'm sorry.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I want to help but it feels risky. I'm sorry.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I want to help but it feels risky. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll do it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. That's my final decision.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. That's my final decision.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happened? He's just standing there.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happened? He's just standing there.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What happened? He's just standing there.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What happened? He's just standing there.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do I do? ...Thaddeus?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do I do? ...Thaddeus?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: The broadcast is open, but the signal is silent. His hard light hologram is uninhabited. Thaddeus is gone.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The broadcast is open, but the signal is silent. His hard light hologram is uninhabited. Thaddeus is gone.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happens now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happens now?

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: I do not know. But the memories have already been transferred to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do not know. But the memories have already been transferred to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?! But I don't feel anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?! But I don't feel anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What?! But I don't feel anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What?! But I don't feel anything.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Give it some time. The memories will manifest first via your unconscious mind. In your dreams.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give it some time. The memories will manifest first via your unconscious mind. In your dreams.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Goodbye Thaddeus...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Goodbye Thaddeus...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: All that effort just to turn me into your personal hard drive?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: All that effort just to turn me into your personal hard drive?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: All that effort just to turn me into your personal hard drive?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: All that effort just to turn me into your personal hard drive?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what was this about? Whether we have figured out all of it or just a little?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what was this about? Whether we have figured out all of it or just a little?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So what was this about? Whether we have figured out all of it or just a little?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So what was this about? Whether we have figured out all of it or just a little?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He wasn't really your friend then.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He wasn't really your friend then.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He wasn't really your friend then.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He wasn't really your friend then.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You can use Egress to mess around with our memories, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You can use Egress to mess around with our memories, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You can use Egress to mess around with our memories, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You can use Egress to mess around with our memories, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What for?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What for?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's why immortality needs memory management?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's why immortality needs memory management?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's why immortality needs memory management?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's why immortality needs memory management?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's madness!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's madness!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you kept your memories somewhere else, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you kept your memories somewhere else, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But you kept your memories somewhere else, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But you kept your memories somewhere else, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You deleted your own memories!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You deleted your own memories!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is there anything supposed to happen right now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is there anything supposed to happen right now?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is there anything supposed to happen right now?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is there anything supposed to happen right now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If so they were extremely unremarkable.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If so they were extremely unremarkable.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If so they were extremely unremarkable.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If so they were extremely unremarkable.

nodes.text: There can be no doubt anymore that Thaddeus edited Ava's memories several times.
Has he stored the memory of Ava's whereabouts in Ava's mind?
